stories.label: Iran war Day 7: Qatar enters combat, Iran fires missiles at Israel, Senate blocks war powers
stories.summary: Day 7: Qatar shot down Iranian jets near US base — first Gulf state combat action. Iran launched missile wave at Israel. US Senate blocked war powers resolution, greenlighting open-ended war. Death toll past 1,000. 2,000-lb bombs. War's blast radius expanding to include neutral Gulf states.

stories.label: Hormuz Day 7: Global energy crisis deepens, data routes severed
stories.summary: Hormuz sealed for fifth day. Pakistan fuel emergency. Cuba blackout linked to fuel shortages. Tanzania fuel prices up 10.76%. Bessent 15% tariff in effect. Russia threatens to halt European gas. Seoul shares rebounding 10% after record sell-off.

stories.label: Lebanon: Israeli ground offensive continues, south of Litani evacuated
stories.summary: Israeli ground offensive ongoing. All south of Litani evacuated. 72+ killed since Monday. Strikes continuing on Beirut and northern Lebanon. Hezbollah retaliating with drone swarms.

stories.label: Nepal votes: first election since Gen Z protests toppled government
stories.summary: Voting underway March 5. 77 died in protests that toppled KP Sharma Oli. Former rapper Balen Shah a serious PM contender. Results expected within days. India and China watching coalition formation.

stories.label: Somalia approves official constitution after 30+ years without one
stories.summary: Parliament approved all 13 chapters of the constitution. First official constitution since Siad Barre's regime collapsed in 1991. Watch for implementation, Somaliland's response, and al-Shabaab reaction.

stories.label: Gaza: Aid collapses under Iran war cover — siege tightens unseen
stories.summary: Fewer strikes but aid entirely cut off. Crossings sealed. Siege tightening while world watches Iran. No new coverage this cycle — continuation is the story.

stories.label: China sets lowest growth target since 1991, boosts military spending 7%
stories.summary: NPC sets 4.5-5% growth target — lowest since Tiananmen aftermath (1991). Military spending up 7% to 1.91T yuan. Science budget up 10%. 'Birth-friendly society' pledge signals demographic crisis. Domestic consumption still weak.

stories.label: US Senate blocks war powers resolution, greenlighting open-ended Iran war
stories.summary: Senate Republicans blocked Tim Kaine's war powers resolution. Congress has effectively greenlit open-ended war. Kurdish ground offensive with US arms still possible.

stories.label: Ukrainian naval drones sink Russian LNG tanker in Mediterranean
stories.summary: Arctic Metagaz LNG tanker sunk between Libya and Malta. Farthest-reaching Ukrainian maritime strike. Putin blames Ukraine, calls it 'terrorist attack.'

stories.label: First wrongful death lawsuit against Google over Gemini AI chatbot
stories.summary: Family sues Google after 36-year-old man's death. First wrongful death case over AI chatbot. Legal precedent implications.

stories.label: GLP-1 weight-loss drugs may halve risk of drug addiction — BMJ study
stories.summary: BMJ study: GLP-1 agonists (Ozempic/Wegovy class) could halve substance abuse deaths. Drugs act on brain reward circuits shared by appetite and addiction. If confirmed, one drug class addresses two major health crises.

stories.label: South Africa's biggest AI data centre to consume 25% of Durban's electricity
stories.summary: 400MW AI data centre planned with South Korean consortium. Would consume 25% of Durban's electricity in a city already suffering load-shedding. Digital extraction — African cities bear energy costs while value flows elsewhere.

stories.label: Big Tech's Gulf data megaprojects trapped between two war chokepoints
stories.summary: Only two data routes in/out of Gulf (Hormuz, Red Sea) both in conflict zones. Undersea cables at risk. Microsoft, Amazon, Google Gulf investments physically trapped. Digital economy's dependence on physical geography exposed.

stories.label: Nestlé sells baby cereal with 15% sugar in Africa, zero in Europe
stories.summary: Public Eye investigation: Nestlé's Cerelac baby cereal contains up to 15% added sugar in Africa, zero in Europe.

stories.label: UK arrests Labour MP's husband and two others for China espionage
stories.summary: Three men arrested for spying for China, including husband of a Labour MP.

stories.label: Cuba blackout: 72+ hours, Hormuz fuel disruption compounds crisis
stories.summary: Western Cuba including Havana blacked out 72+ hours. Crumbling grid, US sanctions, Hormuz fuel disruption compound. Multiple sources reporting continued outage.

stories.label: Google ends 30% app store fee, opens to third-party stores
stories.summary: Google drops 30% Play Store commission. Forced by antitrust and EU Digital Markets Act.

stories.label: PM Abiy warns Eritrea: next attempt to harm Ethiopia 'will be the last'
stories.summary: PM Abiy warned Eritrea. Ethiopia-Kenya agreed joint military operations. Not yet covered but worth watching.

stories.label: China sustains hours-long laser link with satellite 40,000km up
stories.summary: Chinese Academy of Sciences sustained high-speed laser communication with geostationary satellite for hours.

stories.label: AI translations injecting fabricated information into Wikipedia
stories.summary: AI-translated Wikipedia articles swapping sources, adding unsourced sentences.

stories.label: AI avatar 'Gaitana' running to represent Indigenous voters in Colombia
stories.summary: Digital AI avatar 'Gaitana' is public stand-in for two real Indigenous candidates.

stories.label: Children's mole count halved in 25 years — sun campaigns changing bodies
stories.summary: 25-year study: average mole count dropped from 87 to 46. Sun protection campaigns physically changing children's skin development.

stories.label: Sun's 'glitches' during quiet periods explained by scientists
stories.summary: Scientists used helioseismology to explain anomalous vibrations in the Sun during low activity.

stories.label: Lenovo ThinkPads score perfect 10/10 repairability from iFixit
stories.summary: First major laptop line to score 10/10 from iFixit.

stories.label: Khamenei succession: Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner, funeral delayed
stories.summary: Subsumed into main Iran war arc. Mojtaba Khamenei frontrunner. Assembly of Experts hit by Israeli strikes.

stories.label: Pakistan: Karachi shootings, visa suspension, fuel emergency
stories.summary: US Marines fired on protesters. Visas suspended. Fuel emergency declared.

stories.label: Sudan: War grinds on while world watches Iran
stories.summary: War continues with zero global attention. Need anchoring development to re-enter coverage.

stories.label: Ukraine-Russia: LNG tanker sunk, 3-year peak strikes, attention diverted
stories.summary: Iran war diverting weapons and attention from Ukraine. 288 missiles in February — 3-year high. LNG tanker sunk in Mediterranean.

stories.label: 1.1 million Filipino overseas workers at risk across Middle East
stories.summary: 1.1M Filipino OFWs trapped. Multiple countries now running evacuation flights.

stories.label: CBP used ad-tech data to track phones without warrants
stories.summary: Internal DHS document confirms CBP used ad ecosystem location data to track phones without warrants.
